answer.summary: A small, sparse cliffside monastery: a large chapel at the heart, five monks' cells on ledges, a refectory, a scriptorium, a bell tower on the clifftop and a landing at the foot, joined by carved stairs and a ledge walk. Everything here can be built now; the land isn't surveyed yet, so the fit will be checked when it is.
